name: Alexandr Atlas
source:
After graduating from an elite art school, Alexandr Atlas was hired as Morning Glory Academy’s art professor. A prodigy, he takes great pride in his works. Fair-skinned and charmingly handsome, Alexander looks like a prince from a fairytale. He can be arrogant at times but also has a down-to-earth side he’s reluctant to show.

[From Kickstarter]
